# Småmunter börs väntas – RVRC:s vd inför Black Friday

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon talar om en svag öppning efter förra veckans AI-drivna ras: Nasdaq föll över 10% och Stockholmsbörsen 5%. Swedbanks chefstrateg Mattias Isaksson och DNB Carnegies Henrik von Sydow menar att den grundläggande AI-tesen är oförändrad men tycker att det är för tidigt att kalla läget ett köpläge. De lyfter veckans PCE-siffra och Feds förväntningar som de viktigaste triggarna. Revolution Races vd Paul Fischbein beskriver en stark svensk konsument med över 40% tillväxt, en trög tysk marknad, en bra start för I Can I Will och en hög efterfrågan inför Black Friday. The episode discussed a cautious market rebound after last week's AI-driven sell-off (Nasdaq -10%, Stockholm -5%); strategists say the AI thesis is intact but it is too early to call a buying opportunity, with Wednesday's PCE print and Fed expectations as key triggers. Revolution Race's CEO reported strong Swedish demand (+40%), sluggish Germany, a good start for I Can I Will and high Black Friday demand.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Swedbank strategist: likely unfairly punished by AI sell-off; down 20% since early October; bolt-on acquisition and possible Robotics IPO.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Mattias Isaksson, Swedbank) argues ABB fell mainly on AI contagion despite other drivers and intact earnings outlook. He hasn't studied the deal itself. That is a contrarian re-rating case, but no explicit buy call was made, so this is a watch signal.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI sell-off deepens
- if earnings outlook deteriorates
- if Robotics separation fails

> *"Så det är ett typiskt bolag som sannolikt har tagit oförtjänt mycket stryk på grund av den generella AI-forskning som råder just nu."*

---

### 🟡 TEL2-B — Tele2 | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

UBS downgrades Tele2 from buy to neutral.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (UBS), not the hosts' own opinion. A downgrade to neutral implies a hold, and the stock fell about 0.7% on the news.

#### Sell Triggers

- further downgrades
- weak Q4 telecom pricing

> *"UBS sänker sitt råd för Tele2 från köpt till neutral"*

---

### 🟢 TELIA — Telia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

UBS upgrades Telia from neutral to buy.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (UBS) favouring Telia over Tele2. The stock rose 0.3% on a day when defensives were weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if UBS reverses
- if Nordic telecom competition intensifies

> *"medan konkurrenten Telia får ett höjt råd från neutral till köp"*

---

### 🟢 BEIA-B — Beijer Alma | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nordea raises target price and reiterates buy; stock up over 4%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (Nordea), which reiterated its buy with a higher target. The share was the best large-cap performer on the day.

#### Sell Triggers

- if industrial demand weakens
- if Nordea cuts target

> *"Beijer Alma är det som går bäst på large cup, upp över 4&nbspp, där har Nordea höjt riktkursen och upprepar köp."*

---

### 🟠 RVRC — Revolution Race | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

CEO cites >40% Sweden growth, market share gains, strong Q3 seasonality, I Can I Will +24% with better profit.

#### Reasoning

This view comes from the company's own CEO, so it is biased. He describes a high-volume Black Friday and Christmas quarter in which operating leverage offsets the lower gross margin. Germany, the largest market, grew only 1% and the overall market is shrinking. No analyst or host recommendation was given, so this is a watch signal.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Germany turns negative
- if gross margin erodes from heavy discounting
- if Q3 volumes disappoint

> *"en tillväxt över 40 procent. Det slog alla våra egna förväntningar."*

---

### ⛔ VER — Verve Group | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Adj. EBITDA missed; weaker market conditions weigh on revenue growth; stock fell >20% then -11%.

#### Reasoning

Nobody gave an explicit recommendation. The negative signal rests on the reported EBITDA miss and the weak ad market, partly offset by the company keeping its full-year guidance. This is speculative.

> *"Omsättningen kom in i linje med förväntningarna men det justerade ebitdat missade på prognoserna."*
